What is the EFED Streaming Hub?
A Netflix-style platform dedicated to CAW eFed wrestling content. It's a central home base where fans and creators can discover, watch, and share shows from various eFed promotions.
Is it free to use?
Yes — completely free. No subscriptions, no ads, no paywalls. Just create an account and you're in.
How is my password stored? Is it secure?
Your password is hashed using SHA-256 directly in your browser before it ever leaves your device. The EFED Streaming Hub never sees, stores, or has access to your actual password — only the irreversible hash. Your email is stored securely and is never shared with any third party.
Can anyone post videos?
Any registered member can submit videos. All submissions are reviewed to make sure they're genuine eFed wrestling content before going live.
Does watching here count toward YouTube views?
Yes! Videos are embedded using the official YouTube player, so every view on the Hub counts toward the creator's YouTube view count.
What is a CAW or eFed?
CAW stands for Create-A-Wrestler — a gaming community where players create custom wrestlers in games like WWE 2K. An eFed (electronic federation) is an online promotion run by a community of CAW creators who produce shows, storylines, and championships.
What is the Locker Room?
Each eFed page has a private Locker Room — a real-time chat channel exclusive to approved roster members and the eFed owner. It's separate from the public post feed and is meant for in-house communication.
What's the difference between IC and OOC posts?
IC (In Character) posts are written as your wrestler persona — promos, call-outs, storyline content. OOC (Out of Character) posts are written as yourself — real talk, announcements, or general discussion. Both are supported in the post feed.
What is the Trophy Case?
The Trophy Case on your profile lets you showcase championships and titles you've won across different eFeds. You can add belt images, reign years, and link them to the eFed they came from.
How do points and ratings work?
You earn points by engaging with the Hub — watching videos, liking, commenting, and posting. After watching a video for at least 10 minutes, you unlock the ability to leave a star rating. Points and ratings help surface top content and active members.
Is there a limit to how many videos I can post?
There's no hard limit — but we ask that you only submit real eFed show content. Spam or irrelevant submissions may result in your account being reviewed.
How do I report a video or comment?
On any video page, use the flag button in the action bar to report a video. For comments, use the flag icon next to the comment. All reports are reviewed by the admin.
Can I run my own eFed on the Hub?
Yes! eFed owners can apply to have their promotion listed on the Hub. Once approved, you get your own eFed page with a roster, Locker Room, event schedule, post feed, and championship vault.
How do I join an eFed's roster?
Visit the eFed's page and look for the signing link or "Open for Signings" status. Each eFed owner controls their own roster approval process. Once approved, your profile will show under that eFed's roster.
Is my account information private?
Yes. Your email and password are never publicly visible. Only your display name and activity on the Hub (likes, comments, posts) are visible to other members.
Still have questions?
Reach out to us on X/Twitter at @EFEDStreamHub for questions, suggestions, or feedback. If you notice any issues or bugs on the site, please let us know right away so we can address them as quickly as possible.
